hero.title: Field Service Management
hero.subtitle2: Work seamlessly between office and field

intro.title: Build a more effective field service strategy
intro.paragraph: Field activities often involve multiple projects, many staff members, and numerous assets. Fieldworkers can use mobile apps, smart maps, and dashboards to see the real-time status and location of projects and staff. This digitally transformed approach saves money and time by eliminating duplicated efforts and wasted resources and keeping data current.

band.title: Build a more effective field service strategy
band.body: Empower crews with connected mobile workflows and a common operating picture. Use authoritative data, location-aware apps, and dashboards to coordinate tasks, monitor progress, and keep everyone aligned across office and field.

connections.title: See the connections others can’t
connections.intro: Smart maps and dashboards illuminate critical field operations, empower on-the-fly improvements, and reveal deeper insights about projects and resources.
bullets: Ensure field and office staff are using the same authoritative data.
Use real-time dashboards to inform decisions and evaluate key performance indicator (KPI) metrics.
Improve sustainability by reducing or replacing reliance on paper.
Add the power of mobile apps for critical functions such as data collection and route optimization.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.blurb: Transform workflows, reduce errors, boost productivity, and save money with location intelligence technology from the Esri Geospatial Cloud.

items.title: Field Operations
items.body: Gain a location-based perspective on real-time field activities and use visually rich dashboards to inform decisions. See what can be accomplished through working in unison while capturing data and navigating roads—even when offline.

items.title: Real-Time Visualization and Analytics
items.body: Know where assets are and monitor changes in real time. Use big data and Internet of Things (IoT) technology to make quick, informed decisions based on the most up-to-date information.

items.title: Mapping
items.body: Visualize people, places, and assets to gain a clear understanding of all operations in the field. See what's happening across the organization, create a detailed plan, and know where to effectively schedule and dispatch resources.
